result.summary: The page is largely functional, but there are minor layout/visual polish issues around horizontally scrolling content being clipped at the screen edges and some image overlay controls that may be hard to see.

issues.description: The category filter row is clipped on the right edge, with the next chip after “Healthy” partially cut off and no clear fade/arrow affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding, an edge fade, or a scroll indicator so users can tell the filter row continues off-screen.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” carousel truncates the third restaurant card and name (“Trattoria Piccol…”) at the viewport edge, which can look like broken content rather than intentional scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent card peek spacing, edge fades, or snap scrolling so partially visible cards look deliberate and remain readable.

issues.description: Favorite heart icons are placed over food imagery with only a dark translucent backdrop, which may have inconsistent contrast depending on the photo.
issues.suggestion: Use a stronger circular background, stroke, or minimum contrast treatment for icon buttons over images.
